title: Characterization of persistent HPV-specific activated T cells in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Human papillomavirus-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (HPV + OPSCC) generally has favorable outcomes yet remains prone to late recurrence.
